H01g.prompt:
REFERENCES: Image 1 shows the correct pose of the two hands, but drawn too stiff and blocky. Keep its pose, layout, sleeves and finger arrangement exactly, and redraw the hands as natural, slender, graceful young women's hands. Image 2 (Xiao Ke) and Image 3 (DeepSeek) are the character designs, for the sleeves and colours.
PALETTE: Xiao Ke's hand and sleeve use only warm cream #F0EEE6, pale apricot #F2C6A8, terracotta #D97757 and espresso #3B2620. DeepSeek's hand and sleeve use only warm cream #F0EEE6, pale periwinkle #B8C3F7, DeepSeek blue #4D6BFE and deep navy #1B1F4B. No other colours.
POSE (as in Image 1): Xiao Ke's hand from the LEFT edge (cream ruffled cuff, laced cream sleeve with espresso cross-lacing), DeepSeek's hand from the RIGHT edge (cream cuff with two navy buttons, navy sleeve); both arms cut off by the side edges. Each hand is a soft, upright fist: the THUMB lies along the top of the fist; the index, middle and ring fingers are curled into the palm below it, their rounded knuckles visible; ONLY the LITTLE FINGER, the lowest finger of each fist, reaches out toward the other hand. The two little fingers bend and hook around each other in the centre: Xiao Ke's little finger curls down over DeepSeek's, DeepSeek's curls up under Xiao Ke's, interlocking like two links of a chain.
LINE ART (important): both hands are outlined with thin, even, clean contour lines - espresso #3B2620 for Xiao Ke's hand, deep navy #1B1F4B for DeepSeek's - around the whole hand and between every finger, so the thumb, each curled finger and the little finger read clearly.
FINGER COUNT: exactly five per hand (thumb, three curled fingers, little finger). The extended finger is the little finger, opposite the thumb. No extra or merged fingers.
